name: v1.0.0m-11200
body:
## A modified version of Anaron's RageTracker addon.

Shows rage as an independent movable bar (warrior only).

#### Command line options:

`/rt lock` locks or unlocks the bar for dragging
`/rt scalex 0.75` sets the width of the bar to 75% the default
`/rt scaley 0.8` sets the height of the bar to 80% the default

#### Changes:
- Fix fill texture not resizing to bar
- Add saved variables for options
- Add /ragetracker as an alternative unabbreviated command
- Add /rt lock for enabling/disabling mouse interaction
- Make the bar remember its position between logins
